extraction.name: Massive Text Embedding Benchmark (MTEB)
extraction.description: The Massive Text Embedding Benchmark (MTEB) spans 8 embedding tasks covering a total of 58 datasets and 112 languages. It aims to provide clarity on how models perform on a variety of embedding tasks, including bitext mining, classification, clustering, pair classification, reranking, retrieval, semantic textual similarity (STS), and summarization.
extraction.creator: Niklas Muennighoff; Nouamane Tazi; Loïc Magne; Nils Reimers
extraction.inLanguage: en, fr, ru, de, zh, ko, ar, tr, es, it, nl, pl, ja, af, am, az, bn, cy, da, el, fa, fi, he, hi, hu, hy, id, is, jv, ka, km, kn, lv, ml, mn, ms, my, nb, pt, ro, sl, sq, sv, sw, ta, te, th, tl, ur, vi
extraction.citeAs: Niklas Muennighoff, Nouamane Tazi, Loïc Magne, Nils Reimers. MTEB: Massive Text Embedding Benchmark. arXiv:2210.07316v3 [cs.CL] 19 Mar 2023.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The benchmark was assembled by aggregating 58 existing datasets across 8 tasks (including SemEval and BEIR) and creating custom clustering datasets using public APIs from arXiv, bioRxiv, and medRxiv, as well as available data from Reddit and StackExchange.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Existing datasets (such as SemEval and BEIR) and source data from arXiv, bioRxiv, medRxiv, Reddit, and StackExchange.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: MTEB average scores, which are computed over all datasets, are biased towards tasks with many datasets, notably retrieval, classification and clustering.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Very long documents are still missing; summarization consists of only a single dataset; retrieval and clustering are English-only; does not contain any code datasets; focused solely on natural language applications and lacks other modalities.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Benchmarking text embedding models across 8 tasks: bitext mining, classification, clustering, pair classification, reranking, retrieval, semantic textual similarity (STS), and summarization.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: Through versioning at a dataset and software level, we aim to make it easy to reproduce results in MTEB. We welcome dataset, task or metric contributions from the community via pull requests to continue the development of MTEB.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: For custom clustering datasets, the input text was formatted as either the title (S2S) or the concatenation of the title and the abstract/post (P2P). Cluster labels were generated using human-assigned categories; for arXiv papers with multiple categories, only the first category was used. Subsets of labels were selected and articles were sampled from those labels.
